theme: Coordinated source work across eight research directions
question: What source and implementation gaps can a first contribution close in each of eight open directions?
outcome: Eight separate contributions recover object identity, physical face, context, sealing, tablet, lexical, readable-control and construction-phase evidence. Detailed datasets remain local on D:. The reports define residual acquisition and specialist-review requirements.
challenge: Three concurrent worker slots, overlapping prior source histories, source dependence and incomplete physical-use metadata.
remedy: Give eight workers distinct packages, dispatch as slots open, preserve source and protocol versions, review returned prose and counts, and independently inspect the bounded Lothal source chain.
retry_when: The next round supplies one of the object images, catalogue pages, field records or specialist adjudications identified by the eight reports.

authors.role: Eight research workers and a separate bounded source reviewer

authors.model: GPT-6 family; exact root model identifier not exposed
